[lz4](https://github.com/lz4/lz4), tag `v1.9.1` (BSD-2-Clause, `LICENSE`).

`lz4.c`, `lz4.h`, `lz4hc.c`, and `lz4hc.h` are unmodified. `stream/xt3u` wraps `LZ4_compress_HC` for XTool precomp restore (`PrecompLZ4.pas` `LZ4Restore`). v1.9.2+ HC level 12 does not match the prefix used on Songs of Conquest fg-03 patched streams.
